Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play in her backyard with her toys. One day, she found a plastic ball and decided to play with it. She threw the ball and it went very fast.

Suddenly, a magic fairy appeared. She was carrying a sack of plastic toys. The fairy said, "Hello, little one. Would you like to play with me?" Lily said with a smile. The fairy let her in and the playful cup flew out of the sack. It was so pretty that it let Lily play with the toys.
